correctness.rationale: Conditioned on K held coupons, predeletion size grows by Bernoulli((n-K)/n), then binomial thinning with q. Factorial moment recursion m_r[1-(1-r/n)q^r]=(r(n-r+1)/n)q^r m_{r-1} solves the product, and exchangeability yields every inclusion probability and full law. Pair covariance algebra is strictly negative. For q_n=1-c/n, Stirling and improper Riemann sum with bounds j/n<=d_nj<=(1+c)j/n yield I(c); differentiating I(c)-log(1+c) and bounding its integrand proves strict positivity for all c>0, not just numerics. Independent rational full stationary transition kernels for n=2..5 and q=1/3,1/2,3/4 confirmed every inclusion probability and pair covariance.
